sloka: आसीनस्य च ते श्रान्ता पुनरुत्सङ्गमाविशम् ।क्रुद्ध्यन्ती च प्रहृष्टेन त्वया ऽहं परिसान्त्विता ।। ५.३८.१९।।।।
transliteration: āsīnasya ca te śrāntā punarutsaṅgamāviśam ।kruddhyantī ca prahṛṣṭena tvayā 'haṁ parisāntvitā ।। 5.38.19।।।।

translations.english: 'Exhausted, I sat on your lap again. Seeing my angry face you pacified me. You were happy (to see me draw close).
